# Original-reading regression fixtures

All 47 folders are the round-14 handoff's public synthetic source documents and CSV captures, including folders historically named holdout. They are development controls, not fresh blind evidence or real network retrieval.

`expected.json` records the supplied v1 prototype's five relevant sections (ANCHORS, CHANGES, RESTATEMENTS, NUMBERS, TIMELINE), including every red/green/grey row and source-check exit. Prototype DESIGN/EXPERIMENTS/HYPOTHESES screens are not new ResearchGuard source readers and are not replicated. Tests also run the native research evaluation rather than this prototype. Original values and intended outcomes are unchanged.
